To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Cdk12-dependent phosphorylation of Serine 2 in RNA polymerase II (Pol II) is required for the recruitment of the cleavage and polyadenylation (CPA) factor CstF and the subsequent processing of the pre-mRNA 39 end.
Pol II paussing promotes Ser2p and CstF77 recruitment, which is essential for optimal 3' end processing.

Cdk12-mediated phosphorylation of Ser 2 on the RNA Pol II carboxyl-terminal domain (CTDs) promotes the association of CstF-77 with the Pol II elongation complex, which facilitates the recruitment of CstF 64/77 and CstF 50 to pre-mRNA 30 processing sites and promotes 30 processing in human cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms that control the expression of genes.
the molecular mechanisms of pre-mRNA 5′ and 3′ end maturation and the coordination of transcription with pre-mRNA processing.
the mechanisms that control the 3′ end of messenger RNA in eukaryotes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
phosphorylation of Ser-2 of the RNA Polymerase II CTD is a key factor that regulates the 3′ end maturation of pre-mRNA.
the authors show that the Ser2 phosphorylation of RNA Pol II is required for efficient 3′ end maturation of pre-mRNA.
the authors have demonstrated a novel mechanism of coupling transcription to 3′ end pre-mRNA processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CTD phosphorylation is required for efficient pre-mRNA processing and that the CTD is required to promote efficient phosphorylation.
phosphorylation of Ser 2 on the RNA Polymerase II C-terminal domain is required for the recruitment of the cleavage and polyadenylation factors and the cleavage of the nascent transcript.
Cdk12 is required to promote Ser2p, and Ser2p is required for efficient 3′ end cleavage and 5′-to-3′ processing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the phosphorylation of Ser 2 on the Pol II CTD is required for the efficient recruitment of the CstF-77 factor and that the recruitment of CstF- 77 is required for the phosphorylation of the CTD.
Cdk12 is required for optimal pre-mRNA 2′ end formation.
the 3′ end of pre-mRNA is a critical checkpoint that ensures the fidelity of transcription and mRNA processing.
